title: Spirit Stag Sorcerer
description: A mystical blue-violet wolf-like creature with large branching antlers stands dynamically on a dark rock. It has glowing white eyes, golden runes across its body, and raises one paw emitting purple and orange flames while ethereal, multicolored spirit forms swirl around its form against a swirling vortex background.
prompt: A majestic wolf-like creature with large glowing antlers stands on a rocky outcrop, its body covered in glowing golden runes. One paw is raised, summoning purple and orange magical flames. Ethereal, translucent spirit wolves in blue, green and orange swirl around its form. The creature has piercing white glowing eyes and a mystical aura. Dramatic swirling vortex background with golden light rays from above, in a vibrant fantasy style.
